license_policy: Prefer CC0/verified public-domain assets. Store source page, exact license, author, retrieval date, file hash and modifications in manifest. A source page is not proof that a specific downloadable file is compatible with the intended rig.

asset_rules: No binary model is considered production-ready until opened in Blender and checked for missing textures, scale, origin, rig, animation clips and license.
Photos and 3D models must be stored as different asset types.
Human character packs are adult-proportioned; never use as a visual likeness for Mia or Stepa.
All imported files require SHA-256 and source/license metadata.
Character cards reference local files only; URLs remain in reference_sources and the asset manifest until the user downloads the assets.
